problem: The function $U(t)$ models the number of users of a new mobile phone app, $t$ hours after launching the app. What is the best interpretation of ${U}^{′}(4)=650?$

choices.value: $4$ hours after the launch, there are exactly $650$ users.
$4$ hours after the launch, the number of users decreased at a rate of $650$ users per hour
The number of users increased by $650$ during the first $4$ hours
$4$ hours after the launch, the number of users increased at a rate of $650$ users per hour
The number of users increased at a constant rate of $162.5$ users per hour

feedback.problem:
The function $P(v)$ models the price of lemonade sold at a lemonade stand, in dollars, depending on the volume $v$ sold the previous day, in liters. What is the best interpretation of the statement below?

$\,$ *The slope of the tangent line to the graph of $P(v)$ at $v=4$ is equal to $0.5.$*
feedback.worked_solution:
The slope of the line tangent to the graph of $P(v)$ at $v=4$ gives the derivative of $P(v)$ at $v=4.$ So, we have that

$$
{P}^{′}(4)=0.5.
$$

We can interpret the above statement as

$\,$ *When $4$ liters of lemonade are sold the previous day, the price is increasing at a rate of $50$ cents per liter.*

submitted_fields.submitted_value: When $4$ liters of lemonade are sold the previous day, the price increases at a rate of $50$ cents per liter
